steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Test passed. Nothing real was made or sent." [level=1]
  - list "Steps":
    - listitem: "Step 1 of 4: Choose (done)"
    - listitem: "Step 2 of 4: Test"
    - listitem: "Step 3 of 4: Turn on"
    - listitem: "Step 4 of 4: Use your own list"
  - paragraph: On pretend data it would have made 3 e-mails to customers and 1 e-mail to me@example.com. Nothing real was made or sent.
  - paragraph: "Next: turn it on, further down this page. Turning it on sends nothing: before anything is made, you see the exact list."
  - link "Go to Turn it on":
    - /url: "#/checked/d677117d-727f-425d-be2a-ecb19a46c1bf"
  - link "Change settings":
    - /url: "#/make/invoice-chase"
  - paragraph: "Tested on: pretend customers that come with this automation."
  - region "What would have happened":
    - heading "What would have happened" [level=2]
    - group: ▸ Show all 4 in full
  - region "Try it on your real list first (optional)":
    - heading "Try it on your real list first (optional)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drop the list you'd really use. Foundry tests this version on it. Nothing is made or sent.
    - button "Test with my own list"
  - region "What a test can't prove":
    - heading "What a test can't prove" [level=2]
    - paragraph: That your e-mails will arrive, or that your real list looks like the pretend one.
  - article "Turn on 'Chase unpaid invoices' (version 1)?":
    - heading "Turn on 'Chase unpaid invoices' (version 1)?" [level=2]
    - heading "It will" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Read your invoice list and pick the invoices still open (not paid, not disputed)
      - listitem: Write a friendly reminder once an invoice is 7 days late
      - listitem: Write a firmer reminder once it is 14 days late
      - listitem: Write a last reminder once it is 30 days late
      - listitem: "Make each kind of reminder at most once per invoice: it remembers what it already made"
      - listitem: Write a summary for me@example.com of the invoices that are late
      - listitem: Show you every e-mail in full before any is made. You send them yourself, from your own mail app
      - listitem: Check afterwards, by re-reading what it wrote, that exactly the planned e-mails were made, word for word
    - heading "It won't" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Remind customers whose invoice is paid or disputed
      - listitem: Take payments, charge cards or change your invoice list
      - listitem: "Send anything: it writes drafts, and you send them"
      - listitem: Write to anyone except the address on each invoice and the summary address you gave (me@example.com)
      - listitem: "Run by itself: you start each run"
    - heading "How you'll know it worked" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Passed: Every late, open invoice got the reminder its lateness calls for, or already had it"
      - listitem: "Passed: Exactly the planned reminders were drafted, word for word (checked by re-reading the drafts)"
      - listitem: "Passed: The summary for me@example.com was drafted"
      - listitem: "Passed: Re-read the drafts: exactly the planned e-mails were written this run, word for word"
    - group: ▸ How Foundry checks
    - term: "Uses AI:"
    - definition: "no"
    - term: "Tested on:"
    - definition: pretend data, passed 4 of 4 checks
    - term: "Who decides:"
    - definition: you
    - term: "What it needs to go live:"
    - definition: your invoice list
    - button "Turn it on"
    - link "Change settings":
      - /url: "#/make/invoice-chase"
    - link "Not now":
      - /url: "#/automations"
    - paragraph: Turning it on doesn't send anything. It lets you run it, and it shows you what it will make before anything happens.
  - paragraph: "Not going to use this version? Remove the draft: it won't wait for your yes any more, and its test stays in Foundry's records."
  - button "Remove this draft"
